usageNotes: Retrieves the hostname of a running QEMU VM by querying the QEMU Guest Agent (QGA) inside the guest OS. The guest agent must be installed, running, and enabled in the VM's hardware configuration — the call will fail with an error if the agent is not responsive. Use this to programmatically resolve a VM's OS-level hostname without logging into the guest.

examples.summary: Get the hostname of VM 101 on node pve01

tips: Requires the QEMU Guest Agent package (qemu-guest-agent) to be installed inside the guest and the 'Guest Agent' option enabled in Proxmox VM options.
The returned object has a `result` property containing the hostname string as reported by the guest OS — not the Proxmox VM name.
If the VM is stopped or the agent is unresponsive, the API returns an error; always confirm the VM is in 'running' state before calling.
Requires VM.GuestAgent.Audit OR VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted on /vms/{vmid}; API tokens with scoped permissions must include one of these.
